exit_baseline: strategy-declared structural/ATR-proxy stop with fixed-R target (params.target_r); next-bar-open fill; stop-first; forced flat 21:30 Berlin
cost_model: AR1 COST_SCENARIOS (BASE spread x1.0 + 0.5pt slippage); stress: SPREAD_STRESS, SLIPPAGE_STRESS, COMBINED_ADVERSE; commission 0 observed; no overnight so no swap

freeze_rule.note: Pre-registered before any AR2 run. Uses TRAIN and VALIDATION only. Never tuned on OOS.

regime_restriction.note: at most ONE restriction (regime dimension + values) per variant: values with positive expectancy in BOTH train and validation and N above the minima; best by min(train, validation) expectancy

freeze_rule.rejected_early: all variants of a strategy have negative expectancy in both TRAIN and VALIDATION

oos_rule: single evaluation of the frozen set through `ar2_compare.py --oos`; refuses on hash mismatch; OosGate binds full experiment fingerprint
